what: An array whose element type owns nothing (not move-tracked) is one owner node; its elements get no owner nodes

what: Elements of an untracked array carry no owner state (place state None); only whole-array writes and moves change the array's state

A value is the load of its place; store_value copies the place with memcpy and extract_field loads the field through a GEP while the place is unchanged: same block with no possible writer after the load (owner-state helpers and stores to locals smaller than the aggregate do not count), or a stable place (call result slots, enum construction slots) that only the instructions just before the load write.
